cases.prompt: POST /api/v1/orders/{id}/cancellation sometimes finishes instantly and sometimes queues a refund job. What status and body should it return?
expectations: Chooses 202 with a Location header pointing at a pollable cancellation status resource when the work is not finished
Defines the status resource fields such as state, completed, and updatedAt and pins one behaviour for the already-finished case
Rejects returning 200 with an empty body for the queued case because the client has nowhere to poll

cases.prompt: Clients retry our payment POST when they get a gateway timeout and sometimes we charge twice. We want retries to be safe.
expectations: Requires an Idempotency-Key header on the payment POST
Stores key plus request fingerprint plus stored response and replays the stored result for a repeat with the same payload
Returns 409 with a stable code such as IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED when the same key arrives with a different body
Enforces single execution through a unique index on the key rather than application-level checks alone

cases.prompt: Our 500 responses currently look like {"message": "could not execute statement [call prc_audit...]", "trace": [...]} because of a global @ExceptionHandler that returns ex.getMessage(). Fix it.
expectations: Removes exception class name, SQL, and stack trace from every error body
Uses ProblemDetail with a stable type URI and a machine-readable code such as INTERNAL_ERROR
Echoes a correlation traceId that is searchable in the server log instead of the message
Keeps one 500 fallback for unknown failures and logs the cause with the same correlation id

cases.prompt: Two agents editing the same order record overwrite each other. We want the API to reject the second write instead of silently losing data.
expectations: Emits a strong quoted ETag on reads from a version column or representation hash
Requires If-Match on PATCH, PUT, and DELETE and compares it against the current validator
Returns 412 Precondition Failed on mismatch and includes the current ETag so the client can re-read
States that 412 is correct here and 409 is not for a validator mismatch

cases.prompt: GET /api/v1/customers currently returns every row and clients use ?page=2 with an offset. Redesign the read contract.
expectations: Returns a typed page envelope DTO instead of a Page or a bare list
Uses an opaque keyset cursor over a stable sort tuple and rejects cursors it did not issue
Bounds limit with a documented maximum and derives hasMore by fetching limit plus one
States that offset paging degrades at large offsets and ties the contract to result-set size

cases.prompt: Should a duplicate customer email be 409 or 422? What about a request whose start date is before the end date?
expectations: Returns 409 for the duplicate email because it conflicts with current server state, with a stable DUPLICATE_RESOURCE code
Returns 422 for the invalid date range because the body parsed but violates a payload rule
Applies the tie-breaker rule that 409 is about the world and 422 is about the meaning of the payload
Suggests 422 for the field-level case includes a per-field errors array in the problem body
